## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to attach one or more named parameter bindings to a condition template.

### Avoid when

- Avoid forcing a single binding (it is non-functional — a template may bind several slots).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:conditionParameter`](gmeow-conditionParameter.md) from the [`gmeow:Condition`](../classes/gmeow-Condition.md) to each [`gmeow:ConditionParameter`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionParameter.md); the bindings instantiate names used in the condition text or expressions.
